headline: Hakeem Jeffries criticized for private meeting with Jared Kushner
summary: Progressive and pro-democracy voices slam Jeffries for meeting Kushner instead of confronting Trump-era corruption.

voices.quote:
The only meeting Hakeem Jeffries should be having with Jared Kushner is to tell him he’ll be subpoenaed by the House for a corruption investigation on day one of Democratic control of the House.

Establishment Ds cannot stomach progressives talking to left wing media types but they don’t denounce Jeffries meeting with a corrupt oligarch … Jeffries needs to wake up and fire some staff
Ladies and gentlemen…the House Democrats’ leader!
